title: NYC Central Park Night Time Photography Tour
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Amazing view of the Manhattan Skyline
Spectacular images of the Bethesda Fountain, Central Park
Tripod - you must bring your own tripod (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Minors must be accompanied by fully registered adult.
Unfortunately the Central Park at Night session is not wheelchair accessible.
Easily accessible via subway near the Plaza Hotel
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This night time photo tour of Central Park is led by a professional photographer with industry experience. You'll have the opportunity to explore Central Park with your cameras at night. Learn how to take beautiful photos of Central Park in low light. You will also photograph the Manhattan Skyline. The photo tour will end near the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
